lineage.strategy: Reuse the defensible SEC/primary lineage already present and isolate financing/dilution plus successor-bottleneck evidence for Alpha instead of reopening Beta's completed structural thesis.

observedWeaknesses.observation: NuScale remains in commercialization before recurring project cash generation; existing Beta evidence identifies material 2026 ATM issuance and continuing operating losses while technical milestones progress.
observedWeaknesses.whyItMatters: Technical design progress does not remove financing, customer-commitment, construction-cost or shareholder-dilution successor bottlenecks.

risks.risk: Future capital needs can transfer commercialization risk to shareholders through dilution before binding deployments generate recurring cash.
Approved design and supplier milestones can inflate commercialization confidence if treated as proof of funded projects, construction economics or customer conversion.

falsifiers.condition: Binding funded deployments demonstrate competitive construction economics and recurring project cash sufficient to materially reduce corporate equity dependence.
falsifiers.effect: Would reduce financing/dilution and commercialization-conversion risk.

improvementPaths: Track binding customer financing, project-level cost, construction schedule, recurring cash generation and equity issuance dependence.

unknowns.unknown: Binding project economics, financing structure and realized first-plant construction cost remain unproven.

recommendation: Use as source-addressed financing/dilution and commercialization-risk support without assigning Alpha's numeric risk or score.
